name: pcb-design-videos
description: Remotion 教学视频：MP1584EN 非同步降压电路（原理图篇）+ PCB 结构与制作工艺（三段）

scripts.render:sf: npm run render:sf1 && npm run render:sf2 && npm run render:sf3
scripts.publish:sf: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const n of ['sf-01-structure','sf-02-fabrication','sf-03-stack-via']){for(const e of ['mp4','jpg']){fs.copyFileSync(`out/${n}.${e}`,`../public/videos/${n}.${e}`)}}"
scripts.images:sf: npm run poster:sf1 && npm run poster:sf2 && npm run poster:sf3 && npm run publish:sf
